newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pac Dunlop enters Indian condom market.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pac Dunlop enters Indian condom market.

text.p: Industrial conglomerate Pacific Dunlop Ltd said on Wednesday it was to enter the condom market in India through the purchase of 50 percent of Indian-based JK Chemicals.
The acquisition is being made through a new joint venture partnership with Raymond Ltd.

In a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange, Pacific Dunlop said the acquisition would enable its Ansell division, a prolific producer of condoms with worldwide sale of about A$100 million, to establish a stake in the growing Indian market.

The company said India was second largest user of condoms behind China. JK Chemical had about 25 percent of the Indian condom market with annual sales of about A$7 million in both the government and commercial segments.
